title: Cooper's UFO in orbit
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Cooper's UFO in orbit, about Mercury program, ~1963 at Earth orbit, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: uh just that it had come uh in proximity with him and I think he said it was green if I'm not mistaken

plain: A guest named Charlie Foltz, on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, passes on what he says the astronaut Gordon Cooper told him about a flight around 1963 during NASA's first crewed spaceflight programme. According to Foltz, Cooper said an object came close to him in orbit, and Foltz thinks Cooper said it was green. If true, it would mean an American astronaut met something unknown in space.
